title: Supports and repeated members with derived spacing
summary: Keep support length, member count and endpoints related through a native GN generator instead of duplicating shelf meshes.
terms: vertical supports repeated horizontal members count spacing
支柱 横板 段数 間隔 汎用化
shelf shelving low display stand tall rack
棚 展示台 可変 収納ラック

principle.invariant: Four supports and N identical horizontal board instances; N + 4 evaluated instances.
principle.variation: Width, Depth, Height and Levels vary; board thickness and post section stay fixed.
principle.spacing: Board centers span Z=0.09 to Height-0.065. For Levels>=2, spacing=(Height-0.155)/(Levels-1).
principle.safe_use: Require spacing > 0.035 m for positive clearance; choose useful clearance for contents.

evidence.claim: Node connections and source constants define the stated equation.
Low display stand: 1.4 x 0.5 x 0.65 m, 3 boards + 4 posts; tall rack: 0.85 x 0.34 x 1.9 m, 6 boards + 4 posts. Independent copies; saved scene and captured stand reopen and remain editable.
At Height=0.4, Levels=12: measured board-center spacing 0.022273 m is less than 0.035 m board thickness; overlap confirmed.

limits: A shelf family, not a general architecture or structural engineering system.
Low stand / tall rack are parameter variants of one source, not independent discovery evidence.
Transfer to fences, stairs or articulated supports remains untested.

promotion.next: Keep existing GN. New board shapes, attachments or independent furniture cases may justify extracting a broader modular kit.

provenance.source: Project-authored shelf graph and inspected native library; no external tutorial copied.
